scope: Isolated CPU installer code review and temporary/mock fixture tests; no production installer execution, network transfer or GPU work by this audit.
reproduced_before_fixes: Short FileIO writes could publish an archive shorter than the verified in-memory bytes
Partial write followed by OSError could append duplicate prefix bytes on retry
Empty FASTA sequences could be counted as valid records
Modified PDB inventory was ignored during receipt reuse
Zstd stream_reader can return all decoded bytes without error when1–3checksum footer bytes are missing
fixes: write_all plus final file size check; actual partial disk bytes rehashed before resume
All source generation, range, size, CRC32C and MD5 checks use ValueError guards, including under python -O
Single zstd frame/block/footer boundaries checked incrementally; libzstd checksum and full source SHA256/CRC32C/MD5 checked while decoding with bounded reads
Each FASTA header and nonempty sequence validated, including chunk boundaries; symbols counted
PDB inventory hash/stat and every leaf stat verified; no symlink/traversal/duplicate/special-member extraction
Legacy completion receipts upgraded by comparing verified decoded bytes against existing files; no expanded database duplicate or rewrite
Archive or expanded file published immediately before a missing receipt can be recovered by complete verification
resume_procedure: Parent controls stopping only the installer process; this audit did not stop or interact with the running downloader
Terminate the old installer and confirm exit/release of its file lock before starting the same CLI with new code
Retain compressed .partial files and old completed files/receipts; new download() rebuilds hashes and Range offset from disk
Unfinished .installation/*.expanding data are disposable staging and are rebuilt; published legacy files are preserved and compared against freshly decoded verified source
Use a new log and require final status complete plus9 validated v2 component receipts
legacy_upgrade_io: Read compressed source and existing expanded data once for byte-for-byte comparison; no extra expanded copy. PDB inventory is regenerated with leaf stat fingerprints after all comparisons pass.

synthetic_parser_benchmark.dataset: Repeated synthetic valid FASTA records only; not an actual source throughput claim
synthetic_parser_benchmark.limitation: Measures only FASTA validation, excluding source IO, hash computations, decompression and filesystem writing.

dependencies: The system Python has httpx, google_crc32c,zstandard,pytest. The application .venv lacks the optional CRC32C/zstandard packages, so this test module intentionally skips there. No package installation was performed.
